_comment: THE REQUEST BOARD's full mechanical loop. FIXTURE-FIRST (board_loop_start -- the board/Selys machinery is the subject, not the street->guild walk, same precedent as near_guild). Proves, in one continuous run: (1) the board's browse surface (rotation-derived active slate, read-only); (2) accepting a posting via Selys's picker (delta-since-accept baseline, generic + road-cull-specific accept lines), PLUS the journal's own Postings section reading that SAME accepted posting mid-waking (title + OPAQUE 'In hand.' binary status, own heading -- never folded into Quests); (2.5) a real pause-Save/Load round-trip mid-accept, proving accepted_bounty_id/accepted_bounty_baseline survive an actual save-game/load-game cycle, not just WISave's unit-level round-trip; (3) fulfilling the condition via REAL talk_pool interactions (heard_gossip, the shared social-pillar counter -- bounty_gossip_tea rides the SAME counter Renn/Ilvo/Yelra already bank, no new mechanic), then the journal re-read showing the SAME posting flipped to 'Ready to turn in.'; (4) turning in at Selys's desk (gold payout through the shared earn_gold router + a completed_bounty_<id> accomplishment), then the journal falling back to its empty flavor line; (5) a sleep, then the slate ROTATES (board_active_bounties asserted via assert_state, zero-rng determinism) and Selys's 'slate rotated overnight' line fires exactly once; (6) the ABANDON option ('Hand the posting back.') -- accept a second posting from the rotated slate then hand it back, proving accepted_bounty_id clears cleanly (no pay, no penalty), fixing the one-shot soft-lock's second half (the first half -- condition_mode: absolute for the three one-shot-keyed bounties -- is exercised by a separate non-canonical verification script, not this one). Seed 9 for convention; fixture rng_state governs (no combat in this script).

steps._comment: == (0) ROTATION, PRE-STATE == times_slept 0 -> pool window [0,1,2] = road_cull/settle_dispute/gossip_tea. Asserted via state, not dialogue text (the board's assembled text is long/multi-paragraph -- the determinism proof belongs on the derived state, the human-legible copy proof belongs to the windowed screenshot below).

== (1) BOARD BROWSE == guild_board (2,3) sits past Renn (3,3), who blocks a direct westward walk along y3 (the same blocking guild_interior_walkthrough's own script hits at (4,3)). Detour via the open y6 corridor, the same precedent for reaching the board -- straight down the x=8 column now (unblocked (8,4), the old rug-detour sidestep is gone): down 3 to (8,6), left 7 to (1,6), up 3 to (1,3) (column x=1 is clear of both Renn (3,3) and Ilvo (2,4)), then a blocked 'right 1' bump into the board's own cell (2,3) to face right without moving.

== (2) ACCEPT == back to the desk-approach cell via the SAME y6 detour in reverse (down 3 to (1,6), right 7 to (8,6)), then straight up the x=8 column (unblocked (8,4), no more sidestep): up 3 to (8,3), then a blocked bump up against Selys to set facing up. Then Selys: fresh waking, first interact plays her rotating pool line (banks heard_gossip 0->1), second opens the real graph.
Fresh state: idx0 'Just looking around.', idx1 'How does the board work?', idx2 'Take on a posting.' (board_accepted false) -- 'Turn in my posting.' hidden.

Hub body carries the numbered active-slate postings verbatim (the SAME long/paginated surface the board browse view uses) -- speaker-only assertion here, exact text left to the windowed screenshot (see WIBounties.build_picker_graph's doc comment: options must stay SHORT, unwrapped -- the full copy lives in the paginated body, not an option row -- a real off-panel-edge option-text bug caught this the hard way).

Picker options render posting TITLES (WIBounties._posting_title): ['Take: Goblin Cull, Floodplains Road.' (road_cull, 0), 'Take: Settle a Quarrel.' (settle_dispute, 1), 'Take: Gather Gossip for Krshia.' (gossip_tea, 2), 'Never mind.' (3)] -- pick index 2, gossip_tea (cheapest to fulfill in-map: Renn/Ilvo/Yelra's pool lines already bank heard_gossip).

Proves accepted_bounty_id (an additive save field, WISave lines ~185-188/421-424) survives a real save-game/load-game round-trip mid-accept, not just the unit-level WISave.serialize/apply round-trip. accepted_bounty_baseline isn't snapshot()-exposed (assert_state has no path to it -- Game.sim.snapshot() deliberately omits it, same opaque-internal-bookkeeping treatment as other baseline/progress dicts in this codebase), so its exact round-trip is asserted at the unit level in test_save.gd instead; the loaded baseline is still LIVE for the rest of this run (the FULFILL/turn-in steps below read it for real), just not directly assert_state-able mid-script.

steps._comment: == (5) SLEEP + ROTATION == teleport to your_bed upstairs (debug-only, bypasses doors/the guild<->street<->inn walk -- that route is proven elsewhere, e.g. inn_walkthrough/upstairs_walkthrough; the subject here is the board's post-sleep rotation, not overworld traversal). #49: the ground-floor alcove bed is REMOVED, the inn's only bed is upstairs now. `transition()` does NOT touch player_facing, so landing directly on the bed's approach cell facing down (left over from the turn-in leg above) would face the WRONG way; teleport one cell short (9,3) and move up 1 for real, matching the board_loop precedent's own logic, picking up the correct UP facing as a side effect of a real move.

Back to Selys: teleport to the guild, one cell south of the desk-approach cell (facing is still DOWN, left over from the bed leg above -- transition() never touches it), then move up 1 for real to pick up the correct UP facing. New waking -- social_talked cleared, so the FIRST interact plays her pool line again before the graph.
board_accepted false again (turned in before the sleep): idx2 'Take on a posting.' is visible once more.

The 'slate rotated overnight' line: times_slept (1) != board_last_seen_times_slept (0, stamped at the FIRST picker open in step 2 above) -- fires exactly once, as its OWN short bark (DIALOGUE_LINE, same surface as Renn/Ilvo/Yelra's pool lines) BEFORE the picker's dialogue_started, not folded into its (long, paginated) body text.
